scope: kill the false-green push pattern for good; publish the measured corpus status

pushVerification.script: scripts/push-verified.mjs, wired as npm run push:verified
pushVerification.rule: a push is confirmed only by reading the remote default branch and comparing it to local HEAD; the exit code is never the evidence
threePriorFailures: `git push | grep 'main -> main'` — the pipeline's status was tail's
`grep up-to-date` — a commit rejected by the commit-msg hook produced 'up-to-date', counted as success
`git push >/dev/null; [ $? -eq 0 ]` — git returns 0 when there is nothing to push

failureClasses.network: retry (github.com:443 flaps constantly on this machine)
failureClasses.rejectedHook: no retry — the commit never existed
failureClasses.nonFastForward: no retry — the remote moved; retrying made the diverged-remote test take 106s, now 0.8s

cover: already up to date is confirmed without pushing
a new commit is pushed and confirmed by reading the remote
a diverged remote reports NOT confirmed and exits 1
uncommitted changes are named rather than silently left behind

pushVerification.fallback: non-GitHub remotes compare via git ls-remote — the mechanism may vary, the standard may not

ownRealArtifacts.corpora: 120 commits, 19 merged PRs, 3 ADRs, 1 postmortem, 4 runbooks, 1 API reference
